attBesluta.text: This tent is MASSIVE. I am very pleased with the chimney hole and the fire proof material that is used. I do winter camping and the compact packing makes it easy to transport. Also very bright and easy to spot at a distance.
This tent is massive i got a full hassle free refund and reordered a smaller one.

We ordered this basketball hoop for my daughter’s Christmas gift. The first one came with a damaged hoop. Let me say the customer service is EXCEPTIONAL. Instead of just sending us another hoop / they sent over an entirely new unit. I give them 10 stars! So impressed

Der VEVOR Basketballkorb/ständer war ein Geschenk zu Ostern für unsere beiden Jungs (13 und 9 Jahre alt). Die Jungs waren total aus dem Häuschen über das Geschenk. Gut ist ja auch nicht gerade günstig. Aber der Basketballkorb/ständer hält was er verspricht. Mit Hilfe vom Papa haben die Jungs den Ständer samt Korb augebaut und es wurden gleich Körbe geworfen. Das tolle daran ist, dass man die Höhe einstellen kann. Wir haben jetzt eine mittlere Höhe gewählt, die für beide Jungs in Ordnung zu schein sein. Wir haben den Standfuß mit Wasser gefüllt, er wirkt sehr robust. Die Tage hat es ja schon ziemlich heftig gewindet, aber er ist nicht umgefallen. Ich finde es auch gut, dass man den ganzen Ständer bequem durch Rollen am Standfuß hin und her bewegen kann. Zudem sieht der Ständer echt hochwertig aus.

Perfect for moving around. The base is not really sturdy enough to keep the backboard from bouncing around. Not made for the full height and rough play. It would be fine for smaller heights with not so tall kids. It is good quality. The pole and goal are great. I ended up pla ing it in the ground in concrete worked great
Great cargo box looks great on my car. Cuts wind like crazy and helps my car hug the road.

Purchased recently to replace an old Thule Pacific 600. Very happy with the packaging, and quality of build seems great. We travelled 3000kms+ over the recent holidays, the pod travelled well in our Mazda 6 Wagon, it was quiet, and stayed entirely water proof. It carried a large off road pram, a large beach shelter, 3 bags of clothes and 2 picnic blankets. Very happy with it!

Used these as part of a wedding ceremony backdrop and they were a hit. Dense, full foliage added so much life to the venue without the risk of wilting. The wire stems are flexible and easy to arrange. Incredible value for two large ferns.

I hung these on my front porch and had multiple guests ask for watering tips—they couldn't tell they were fake. The fronds are soft and lifelike, and the branches hold their shape even in windy weather. Zero maintenance, all beauty.
